result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small companies, I'd recommend **BambooHR or Rippling** for HR management, or **Gusto** if payroll is your biggest priority.

The best choice depends on your company size, location, and how much HR administration you want to automate.

## Best HR software for small businesses (2026)

![How to Use BambooHR - Getting Started Guide (2026) | Delv](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1eEILrPS5kwPkgNwYw7R5-fSnQEm5WOJ3mO9wAe9tHrox_ii2fkN7RtteSGmwi-6qitJLoQZs1FRAP2kjVoJ49Jp-AjTjDQtr9b5VlRxrraDCzcOaPuqAcc3XeVxoctViebYCP_ecjlJwjlD7MBkZOx5riXcchKDVW9q8jz3YTQ7r9I5oNzcVbSfteMz5-Pg?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall for HR)

- Employee records and document management
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Vacation and leave tracking
- Performance reviews
- Employee self-service

Best for companies wanting a dedicated HR platform.

Pricing: Quote-based; published estimates vary by company size.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

- HR, payroll and benefits
- Automated onboarding
- Employee IT and software access
- Time and attendance
- Workflow automation

Best for companies expecting to grow quickly.

Pricing: Modular, starting estimates around \$8/employee/month plus a base fee.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Gusto**

(Best for payroll)

- Payroll processing
- Tax filing
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits administration
- Basic HR management

Best for smaller businesses wanting payroll and HR together.

Pricing: US plans start around \$49/month plus \$6/employee.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee database
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Employee performance
- HR workflows

Best for small companies looking to keep costs down.

Pricing: Free tier available; paid plans start at low per-employee rates.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BwBSbYO2w6fmiCza1cBB8CDNPx_RGELihr60dseklDBbkuXDKzQOsxDktUEaDbD9eHSkNEPdSztx6z5L7KWxwVZH6jhtvniCjHZWiwmIza8fJetVNFNkUW8nWMsCjN0tGPj3-bOa13wJXpjw3ACWKyqTPuzFSlzhsqOQpRdXN0K27NHCCyfrXWBE73H0_NmY?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Deel**

(Best for international teams)

- Global employee management
- Contractor management
- International payroll options
- Onboarding
- Compliance support

Best for companies employing people in multiple countries.

Pricing: Core HR starts around \$5/employee/month; payroll services cost extra.

[Deel website](https://www.deel.com/)

Pricing is indicative, not a quote. Some prices are US-specific, and availability varies by country. ## My recommendation

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Overall HR management | BambooHR |
| HR automation and growth | Rippling |
| Payroll and HR together | Gusto |
| Lowest-cost HR management | Zoho People |
| International employees | Deel |


One important consideration: If your company is in Canada, make sure the platform supports Canadian payroll, tax deductions, employment standards, and benefits administration. US-focused payroll products aren't automatically suitable.
